name: deskguard-full-site
description: DeskGuard — live library desk map with QR check-in

scripts.start: cd client && npm run build && cd ../server && NODE_ENV=production node src/index.js
scripts.install:all: npm run server:install && npm run client:install
scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c green,cyan "npm run server:dev" "npm run client:dev"
scripts.test: cd client && npm test && cd ../server && npm test
